nom: Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Face Cleanser

avis.texte: I first tried the foundation balm and was amazed by the coverage and how it feels on my skin and the results of lighter redness on my skin. Then after two weeks of using the balm foundation I purchased (2) cleanser. Love the cleanser. Only request is could you put a flip top lid on it? It's just easier to use than the screw on lid. I'm spoiled because I buy your clarifying lotion with the pumper and the dramatically different moisturizer with the pump. So the flip lid on the cleanser would be awesome.

This one took a little getting used to at first as I am a person with "texture" sensitivities. I haven't used a cream cleanser before this one, but I am officially a convert. I tend to use this as the first clease especially on days when I have makeup on and then follow it up with a regular face wash. This helps prevent my face from feeling stripped afterwards. It makes a big difference at night since I do my normal routine in the morning. Definitely worth a try if you have sensitive skin and texture issues. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This cleanser was great! I love that it's gentle on the skin and fragrance free. The non foaming aspect took a bit of getting used to. It's super convenient to use and requires very little water which I love. My skin feels amazing after using it.

Clinique daily calm gentle cream cleanser-I really enjoyed this! I used it in the shower getting ready, when taking my makeup off at night, or as just a refresh from being outside and sweating making my face oily. I've never used a cleanser like this. It surprised me when the directions said to use on dry face and massage all over the face including the eyelids, then wipe off with a damp cloth. No rinsing needed. So simple and easy! I love that it is great for sensitive skin, fragrance free, and it cleansed and hydrated my skin so nicely. Skin felt so soft. My combination skin loved it. I plan to purchase when I run out. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Perfect Daily Cleanser for Busy Days
avis.texte: This cleanser has become my go-to both morning and night. It glides on silky smooth—I absolutely love the feel on my skin! I enjoy the texture and light scent immensely; everything about this product is amazing. It effectively removes impurities while keeping my skin balanced and comfortable all day long. No tightness or irritation, just pure gentleness. It's a staple in my skincare now. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I really like the Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser. The best part is how convenient it is: I can apply it to dry skin and wipe it off with a warm washcloth, which makes me much more likely to use it than fully washing my face. Seriously, it's the perfect lazy girl product. It's gentle on my skin but still removes my makeup well. I haven't experienced any irritation or breakouts, and my skin feels clean and comfortable after using it. It's a great everyday cleanser that balances convenience with effective cleansing. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

The product seems to be very good and tailored for people with sensitive skin. It easily takes off makeup, has no smell, and feels very lightweight. I would recommend if you are sensitive to smells and want to try a new cleanser! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I really enjoyed trying this cleanse it is gentle great on the skin no irritaion so far i love how it makes my skin smooth.I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I usually put this product on in the morning with my skincare routine. It goes in so smooths and just melts into my skin. It leave me soft and moisture. I will be buying another one amazing results. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This cleanser feels incredibly gentle on my skin but still removes makeup, sunscreen, and daily buildup without leaving my face feeling tight or dry. My skin feels clean, soft, and comfortable after every wash. It's a great option if you have sensitive skin or just want a simple, reliable cleanser that doesn't strip your skin. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

The Daily Calm cleanser is very refreshing. I've used it at night and in the morning and prefer at night. I really feel like it cleanses away the day's dirt and oils. It's new to me to use a cleanser without water rinsing, but I understand that's how it works. The ability to use around my eyes is really great and proof of how gentle it is. The light scent was also a plus. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Clean, soft skin without the greasy feel of balms
avis.texte: I am in my mid-50s with dry, mature skin that tends to be sensitive. I use this cleanser at night to remove my makeup and wash away the oil and grime of the day. My skin feels clean and soft afterward instead of tight or stripped. The texture itself is light, smooth, and spreads easily across the skin without feeling heavy or filmy. I also use it on my eyelids and see no irritation, and there is no odor at all. I typically use IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Makeup or the Drunk Elephant Makeup Melting Butter for makeup removal, but I think I am going to switch to this Clinique cleanser after using it for two weeks. It gets the job done without being greasy, unlike those other balms, and it is also much easier to rinse off. It is also not as thick as Pond's can be. It is comparable in pricing to the IT Cosmetics and Drunk Elephant options, a bit less expensive, but the feel on my skin is so much better. I am really impressed with this cleanser. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
I received this product for testing purposes from Top Box Circle. This product worked great. It was moisturizing on my skin.

avis.titre: Gentle on skin, not good for makeup removal
avis.texte: This cleanser is super gentle and great for sensitive skin. I found that it did not take off makeup really at all, so this is definitely a step 2 of a double cleanse if you are wearing makeup. It's an interesting cleanser because it does not sud up at all, instead it's a very creamy consistency throughout the process. I like to use this in the morning as my cleanser since I don't have makeup on and my skin has had zero reactions to it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I have sensitive skin and Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser is extremely gentle. I love that it is fragrance free. This cleanser great was great when I wanted to cleanse my face on the go because no water is needed. Just wipe on and wipe off with clean cloth. This leaves my face feeling smooth and hydrated. I noticed an improvement of the texture of my skin along with reducing redness. This will be a product I will purchase in the future. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I have pretty sensitive skin, so I'm always nervous about trying new face washes. I've been using this one for a few weeks now, and I actually really like it. It gets my skin clean without leaving it feeling dry or tight afterward, and I haven't had any irritation. I also like that it doesn't have a strong scent. It's simple, but it works, and I'll definitely buy it again. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I really enjoyed using this Clinique daily calm gentle cream face cleanser. It didn't strip my skin and dry it out. It felt very mild and non irritating. The texture was nice and it foamed up nicely as well. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This cleanser is something I had no idea I needed. I have 2 young children, I am a caretaker for two disabled family members, and I am in college. Time is absolute gold for me right now so I'm always looking for ways to save it. I was skeptical at first, but I was skeptical about dry shampoo at first too. For about 2 weeks now, I've been using this in place of a cleanser that requires water, morning and night. My skin is doing just as well as it usually does, but I haven't felt the need to slather my face in lotion because of that process. My skin is more hydrated, I save time, and I don't have to worry about water running down my arms or making a mess. If you or someone you know is drowning in fun stuff like responsibilities, please treat yourself or them and buy this. It is well worth it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. This is by far the most hydrating cleanser I have ever used. Feels great on the skin, cleans it well and doesn't dry me out at all like alternative products do. A little bit of it goes a long way & there is so much of it. Super impressed by this cleanser and will likely repurchase!

I found this to be a pretty basic cream cleanser that worked well when my skin was acting up or I wanted something more gentle. It doesn't really suds up and more so feels like rubbing a light creamy lotion on your skin that you rinse off. You get a good amount of product in the tube and I didn't need very much to clean my entire face. It doesn't clean off makeup well though, so you definitely need an oil or other melting cleanser first. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I recently went on a trip to Vegas and packed this as my cleanser. It made things so easy! I absolutely love the convenience of this. It makes washing so fast and so easy that you still do it even when you just wanna hit the pillow! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

As a 55-year-old woman with a consistent 16-step skincare routine, I'm particular about cleansers. Daily Calm has earned a spot both morning and night. The creamy texture feels hydrating rather than stripping, my skin feels genuinely clean afterward, and it even does a good job removing mascara without irritating my eyes. No noticeable scent, which I appreciate. Not quite a holy grail for me, but a lovely gentle cleanser I'll keep reaching for. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

absolutely love the Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser! It has a rich, creamy texture that feels so gentle on my skin and doesn't cause any irritation. It cleanses thoroughly without stripping away moisture, leaving my skin feeling clean, soft, and incredibly smooth after every use. My face feels refreshed and comfortable, never tight or dry. This has quickly become one of my favorite daily cleansers. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Very nice for sensitive dry skin!
avis.texte: It's a nice face wash, though it wasn't life changing. I do feel like it doesn't strip my skin and feels very soft during the wash. I usually use this as my "evening" face wash after my oil cleanse and before I apply tretinoin. I feel like the pair of this and the Daily Calm repair cream it has circumvented a lot of irritation that can occur if I accidentally apply too much of the tret! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I used this cleanser morning and night. It just needs a wet cloth to wipe off the cleanser. It is a good cleanser for people with sensitive skin, it worked good on the eyelids as well. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
This cleanser has a good texture, doesn't leave skin feeling tight. Good for all skin types. This product was provided for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes

Clinique's Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser has quickly become a holy grail product for my sensitive skin. This product comes in a sturdy tube that makes it easy to dispense. The product itself has a soft, creamy, smooth texture. It gently lathers onto my skin then can be washed off with a warm damp cloth. This face wash is effective at removing the dirt and oil from my face. It keeps my skin feeling soft and smooth! I love that it contains glycerin and hyaluronic acid to keep my skin healthy, strong, and hydrated. This formula is so gentle on my sensitive skin. After using this product twice daily, I have noticed that my skin has less redness and appears more healthy and radiant. I love the subtle botanical scent. I have been highly satisfied with this product and I am excited to continue to use it! *I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.*

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. This cleanser does an excellent job of removing dirt, oil, and daily buildup while leaving my skin feeling fresh and clean without stripping away its natural moisture. The creamy texture feels incredibly gentle and soothing during use, making it a great option for my sensitive skin. I also appreciate how soft and hydrated my skin feels after rinsing—there's no tightness or dryness, just a comfortable, healthy feel. With continued use, my complexion has looked calmer, smoother, and more balanced. Overall, this is a gentle yet effective cleanser that has become a staple in my skincare routine.
Smells very neutral not offputting no burning sensation Smell reminds me of cetaphil moisturizer

This cleanser is amazing! It is so convenient to use and feels great on the skin. You apply it to dry skin and then remove with a damp cloth, so it is very mess free and easy to fit into a routine. My skin looks and feels great and there are no harsh scents in this cleanser. Highly recommend! "I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes."

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. This cleanser is very gentle and non-drying. I have oily skin, so I am not sure that I would purchase this product as I prefer more of a deep clean of my skin. This would be great for those with dry skin who want to retain more moisture and don't have as much oil to wash off at the end of the day.

As someone who has rosacea, I have noticed the redness on my cheeks has been significantly reduced since I have started using Clinique's Daily Calm™ Gentle Cream Cleanser. I use it at night to remove my makeup and wash away the day. Unlike other cleansers, this one does not foam. It has more of a creamy consistency and left my skin feeling moisturized and clean. It did not leave my skin dry or tight which is really important for keeping my skin looking calm. I LOVE that this is fragrance free as that is usually one ingredient that causes irritation. Sometimes it is difficult to find a cleanser that doesn't include fragrance. It is a little pricy, but it is worth a shot if you are struggling with sensitive skin. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Gentle, Fragrance-Free Cleanser for My Nighttime Routine
avis.texte: I've been using the Clinique Daily Calm™ Gentle Cream Cleanser as part of my nighttime routine and have really enjoyed it. The creamy texture feels soft on my skin and cleanses without leaving my face feeling tight or dry. It removes everyday dirt and light makeup well while keeping my skin feeling comfortable and hydrated. One of my favorite things about this cleanser is that it's completely fragrance-free. I really enjoyed the fact that there is no scent, making it feel even gentler and more relaxing to use before bed. After using it consistently, my skin feels clean, calm, and refreshed. Overall, it's a great everyday cleanser if you're looking for something mild yet effective. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I really like how smooth and creamy this cleanser is. I typically use it after removing my makeup. It is more of a lotion feel, so a bit heavier but great if you have dry skin. I would not use it daily but it is nice to have as a cleanser. It is a great size and a little goes a long way. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. This is such a nice cleanser and that feels very great when applied to the skin. I easily have photo how gentle this cleanser is and how easy it was going to be to cleanse my face. I enjoy how the texture of this cleanser is actually very light and there is really no smell to it just freshness which I prefer. I like really using this in the morning because I sometimes just want to quit cleanse and to make sure my face is clean after long nights. This also is very nice to use as a second cleanser when removing makeup that was heavy on the face to get the skin thoroughly cleanse and feeling soft. Overall I just really enjoyed this and I like to see how gentle and calm my face is after using this each time

This product is amazing as is all of cliniques products, left my face feelings clean, smoothe and refreshed. Easy to use. Instructions are plain and simple. It's safe for around the sensitive eye area. Overall its one of my favorite cleanser creams. Non greasy. : I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This is a great gentle cleanser. I have been using it twice a day with no redness or irritation. It has no noticeable scent and a creamy consistency. My skin feels soft, clean, and moisturized after using this, and I would recommend it! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Clinique Daily Calm Cleanser is gentle and soothing on the skin. I doesn't foam and feels like you are applying a cream, it cleanses well without leaving my face feeling dry or tight, and my skin feels soft and refreshed after using it. A great everyday cleanser, especially for sensitive or easily irritated skin. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I love this cleanser! It has no scent and removes all traces of makeup and oil. I've been using it for a couple weeks and it hasn't caused any breakouts which can be a problem for me with some cleansers. I will definitely be buying this again when I run out. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This gentle calming cleanser is not the best but works decently. My skin is very sensitive and gets blemishes often. So I decided to give this product a try. This product worked best for me when I used it as a morning cleanser. The formula truly is gentle and does not cause any irritation at all. It also did not leave my skin feeling dried out. Which is great! However, I noticed that this cleanser was not that great at removing all the dirt and oil from my skin. Which is why I think it works best as a Morning cleanser. (I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes).

I find that this cleanser works well. I like how easy and quickly it cleans, including all kinds of makeup. I love that it's for the whole face, and I don't need a separate cleanser for skin around the eyes. I just massage a small amount all over my face and wipe it with my makeup-removing cloth. No need to rinse. It doesn't leave any oily residue; my skin feels clean without overdrying. I also like that it's fragrance-free and for all skin types. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This has been a wonderful addition to my skincare routine. It has a creamy texture, rinses away easily, and leaves my face feeling calm, smooth, and refreshed. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Perfect for cleansing and preparing the skin
avis.texte: It's a cleansing cream, it doesn't lather and it's fragrance-free, which makes it perfect for sensitive skin. I use it twice a day, morning and night, but it's not very good at removing makeup, so I guess it's not really for that. I prefer to remove my makeup with micellar water, then I use this cleansing cream to remove any remaining makeup with a damp towel, Leaving my skin ready for the rest of my skincare routine, it has reduced redness and left it feeling hydrated and glowing. It's definitely worth trying. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I'm a great user of Clinique products especially the facial washing products. I have found this new addition to my routine a very good choice, it is reasonably priced successfully effective in cleansing my skin and without drying it out.

I loved this cream cleanser, it's smooth and silky and it keeps my skin soft and smooth. Definitely good if you have redness or sensitive skin! I used it daily in the shower and I love the way my skin feels.

I find this cleanser is very gentle for my sensitive skin. I typically use cream to foam cleansers, so this concept was very different for me. Directions say to massage over a dry face and use a damp cloth to wipe off with no rinsing required. I personally do prefer to fully rinse my face after using any cleanser. I love that it has no scent! I received this product for free for testing and review purposes in exchange for my honest review.

As someone with oily skin I was not wowed by this product. I liked that it had no scent, but it didn't feel like it was truly cleansing my face and stripping my oils. I used it morning and night and still never felt that much of a difference. I wouldn't recommend this to other people with oily skin because you'd probably want something that really gets in there and cleanses. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes

I've been using this Clinique cleanser both morning and night, and it's been a great addition to my skincare routine. It creates a gentle lather that leaves my skin feeling clean, fresh, and soft without stripping away moisture. The formula feels lightweight, rinses off easily, and doesn't leave any tight or dry feeling afterward. I also appreciate that it's fragrance-free, making it comfortable for my skin. Overall, it's a reliable cleanser that leaves my face feeling refreshed and ready for the rest of my skincare routine. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
I loved this for sensitive acne prone skin. It was gentle yet effective. I loved that it lathered well with no fragrance!

I've used this cleanser in the morning and at night. It's the most gentle cleanser I've ever used. The skin didn't feel any dryness at all. The texture is really creamy and doesn't foam so it's easy to apply. It has a very mild scent. The only thing that u didn't like that it's recommended not to rinse it off but just to wipe it off, which At nights felt like not enough cleaning to remove whole day buildup. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: The Only Skin Cleanser You Need
avis.texte: The Clinique Daily Calm™ Gentle Cream Cleanser is my new go-to soothing cleanser for daily skin care. I particularly appreciate its gentle cleansing properties, which make it suitable for my sensitive skin. It effectively removes makeup, excess oils, and impurities without the need for additional cleansing products that may strip the skin of its natural moisture or leave your skin feeling oily. The Clinique Daily Calm™ Gentle Cream Cleanser is lightweight and fragrance-free, making it ideal for those with sensitive skin or those who wear makeup, including eyeliner, mascara, and eyeshadow. It removes makeup without irritating the delicate skin around the eyes. The Clinique Daily Calm™ Gentle Cream Cleanser is not oily; however, you really don't have a need to follow it with a moisturizer. By morning, my skin remains satiny soft and hydrated. Just apply, enjoy the soothing moment, wipe off, and go about your day with glorious glowing skin with or without any makeup. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Best cleanser I've used in awhile
avis.texte: I've been using the Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser for a little while now, and it's quickly become one of my favorite cleansers. The creamy texture feels really soothing, and it removes dirt, oil, and light makeup without leaving my skin feeling tight or dry. After every wash, my skin feels clean, soft, and refreshed. I have sensitive skin, so I appreciate how gentle this cleanser is. It doesn't cause irritation or leave any residue behind, and it works well with the rest of my skincare routine. It's a simple, reliable cleanser that keeps my skin feeling balanced. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
This is an amazing product and you won't regret itl received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Cream cleanser was new to me. At first, I was weirded out by the instructions since they're so different from foam cleanser, but after a few uses, I get why people use this! For my dry skin, I always feel tight after washing with foam cleanser, so much so that I rush to put on lotion. But with cream cleanser, I didn't have to! The idea of hydrating skin while cleaning is fascinating. It's like a moisturizer, and the smell isn't offensive and is subtle. I'd recommend it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I have been using Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser for several weeks. It is a creamy non foaming cleanser that has no scent. It cleans my face without drying it or making my skin feel tight. I rub it on my eyelids as well and it does not irritate my eyes. I follow it up with Clinique Daily Calm Soothing Repair Cream and love how my skin looks and feels. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I absolutely fell in love with this cleanser after the first use. It's gentle enough that my face feels clean, but does its job to help my skin look radiant without being red. I have incorporated this into my daily routine and I'm so happy that I found such a wonderful product that is just what I need for my face! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: The Perfect Gentle Cleanser for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I have been using the Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser, and it has quickly become a staple in my daily skincare routine. If you are looking for an easy, fuss-free way to clean your skin without stripping it of moisture, this is absolute gold. What makes this cleanser stand out is the unique application process which you apply it directly to a dry face. It goes on incredibly smoothly, feeling like a rich, soothing cream and then you simply wipe it off with a wet or damp towel. It's incredibly convenient and feels amazing on the skin. It cleans your face really well by removing all dirt and oils. There is also no smell to the cleanser. I highly recommend this cleanser for anyone who dislikes putting harsh chemicals on their face. It is gentle, incredibly nourishing, and leaves your skin feeling clean, soft, and completely calm. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I really like this cleanser and especially love that I don't need to rinse it off, which means less chance of drying my skin out. I'm using it at night and in the morning, and I love the way my skin feels really healthy and clean after using this! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

It took me a while to get used to this cleanser. I'm accustomed to ones that give a slight tingle, but after consistent use, l appreciated how effectively this gentle cleanser works. It has a lovely creamy texture and leaves my skin moisturized. Clinique did an excellent job with this formula!

I was given this product by Clinique for testing and review purposes. I found this cleanser to be so gentle and hydrating. I loved using it first thing in the morning. It never left my skin feeling taunt or irritated. It is not a cleanser I would recommend to remove a full face of heavy makeup. It is a calming and fragrance free cleanser. I would definitely consider purchasing this product in the future.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I've been using the Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser every morning and night and it's been super gentle but still gets my face clean. The texture is a thick cream that feels soft going on and it rinses off without leaving my skin tight or dry. My skin stays comfortable after I wash, not burning or irritated. There isn't a strong scent, which I really like, and my face has been looking calmer and less red since I started using it. If your skin gets easily annoyed by cleansers, this is a nice everyday option that doesn't do too much.

I've been loving this cleanser and it has become a product I look forward to using every day. I usually use it in the morning and at night, and I really like how gentle it feels on my skin. The texture is smooth and easy to apply, creating a soft foam that makes cleansing feel like a little self-care moment. It leaves my skin feeling fresh, clean, and hydrated without that uncomfortable tight feeling. My face feels soft, balanced, and ready for the rest of my skincare routine.

I started using this cleanser a month ago and I am in love! It makes my skin feel so clean and soft after I use it. I have noticed decreased redness in my skin as well. I use this both morning and evening to help my skin stay nice and clean.I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've really been loving this face cleanser. My skin can be a little sensitive at times, and this is so gentle on it. It has no fragrance from what I can tell and is completely neutral. I've been mixing this in with my nightly routine and my skin just feels so much cleaner and brighter. This is a great staple product! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This is a very hydrating yet powerful cleanser. I am very sensitive to cleansers and this did not break me out. It lather is really nicely and clean my skin perfectly. It did not dry my skin out, which is really good. I love using this first thing in the morning. My skin feels so fresh.

I am a longtime Clinique user and I use their cleansing products. I really enjoy this one and I find it as the perfect product to add into my morning routine. It is very soft, gentle and hydrating on my skin and it doesn't leave irritation or redness for me. I have normal skin and find this product works really well!

I liked how this product made my skin hydrated. I used this product in the afternoon. The texture of the product is different then I'm used to. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. The Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser is a lightweight facial cleanser that effectively removes impurities without feeling harsh on the skin. Since I have dry skin, I prefer cleansers that thoroughly cleanse without leaving my skin feeling rough or stripped, and this product met those expectations. After each use, my skin felt clean, hydrated, and comfortable, with no redness or irritation. On days when I feel that a deeper cleanse is necessary, I prefer double cleansing with this product rather than reaching for an exfoliator, which can sometimes be too abrasive for my skin. I appreciate that the formula is gentle enough to help maintain my skin's natural barrier while still providing an effective cleanse. The generous amount of product included also offers excellent value, making it practical for daily use without frequent repurchasing. I typically use this cleanser as part of my nighttime skincare routine, while in the morning I simply rinse my face with water before applying a hydrating moisturizer and sunscreen. Overall, this is a gentle, hydrating cleanser that has become a dependable part of my daily skincare routine.

I was absolutely shocked and wowed by this product! I've never liked cream cleansers that don't lather until this one. It feels so lush and soft going onto the skin dry and when I add water slightly to it the texture stays the same feeling creamy and soft. It feels like I'm giving myself a facial everyday. Once I rinse it off my face is so moisturized and hydrated. As a dry skin girly that's hard to come by. The only 2 cons I have is the price and the fact I ran through it in a month. This is a product I absolutely recommend!!! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I have been using this product every night for a month. I have definitely noticed a reduction in redness and more hydration. Although it doesn't make a lather, it still makes my skin feel very clean and hydrated. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I love this cream cleanser! It doesn't dry my face out, makes my skin feel clean but not stripped & doesn't break me out! I used it every night to help take my makeup off and it helped with that too. Very light scent, if any, and very creamy! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

The Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser is creamy and hydrating. It leaves my skin feeling clean and moisturized. I use it every morning and it doesn't strip my skin. My skin is left soft and supple. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I absolutely love this cleanser! It's incredibly gentle and soothing on my skin. It cleanses without leaving my face feeling tight or dry, and my skin feels soft, calm, and comfortable after every wash. If you have sensitive or easily irritated skin, I highly recommend giving this a try. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

The Clinique Daily Calm™ Gentle Cream Cleanser is the gentlest face wash that I've ever used. I have been consistently using it as a second cleaner and love the moisturizing feel. Earlier this summer, I had a weekend filled with outdoor events. My skin was a little tender from being in the sun for so long. This cleanser was the soothing cool I needed to calm my skin. I'd recommend it to anyone with any issues of sensitivity. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I used the cleanser both in the morning and again in the evening before bedtime. Love how creamy and hydrating it is. I enjoy how easy it takes off my makeup. It's gentle on the skin and leaves it feeling smooth, clean and moisturized. It's also fragrance free. It doesn't make your skin feel tight either. I received this product free from Clinique for testing a review purposes.

This is a lightweight cream that was very gentle to my skin. It actually felt like a moisturizer. I followed the directions and used a damp cloth to remove it. It did a good job removing makeup and normal cleansing of my face. I experienced no irritation around my eyes. My skin felt so soft after using it. There was no leftover stickiness or tightness. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Wow I was very impressed after using this product!! Its so good for your skin, truly no more redness after using!! I swear even my makeup looks better after using this a couple weeks! I definitely recommend!! #I received this product for free from clinique for testing and research purposes

I really liked how this cleanser was gentle on my skin. I have very sensitive skin & I didn't have any irritation at all. Huge plus was that there was no fragrance. It also didn't strip my face from its natural oils. 10/10 highly recommended.
Great cleanser for sensitive skin, it didn't irritate me or break me out, it left my skin clean but not too dry. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This cleanser does what it says, it really is calming and non-irritating to my sensitive skin. It truly cleanses my skin without leaving it feeling dry and stripped. I would highly recommend. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I like the how easy it is to use, you apply it to dry skin and wipe off. It leaves your skin soft and free from debris and dirt. This is good for part of an evening skincare regimen. I used to along side the cream. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This cleanser truly is a gentle cleanser. After use it doesn't leave the skin feeling tight or stripped of all moisture. Certainly this is gentle for sensitive skin types. There is no fragrance. It doesn't foam at all. Rubs into the skin easy and then wipes off just as easy too. Since it is super gentle don't expect this to clean any pores or get off any heavy makeup. I used this product more as an everyday cleanse in the morning and night. I was having skin barrier issues and using this cleanser in combo with the cream was great for repairing it! I would totally recommend if looking for something gentle for everyday use. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I was gifted by Clinique for my honest review. This face cleanser is very creamy . It doesn't really have much of a scent . It also doesn't lather very much . It is a very creamy milky cleanser . It does a great job at cleansing my face without stripping the barrier , it's very gentle and works nicely , I think this is a great one for dry skin .

avis.titre: Removes oil and impurities protects from breakouts.
avis.texte: Great cleanser very gentle and prevents breakouts. This cleanser helps get rid of the excess of oil and impurities great after working out this does not affect the skin barrier with does not cause breakouts. I am glad I received this to test. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This is a thick formula that doesn't lather. Instead it kind of emulsifies all the dirt and makeup on your face and wipes everything away. Doesn't feel sticky, leaves skin soft and silky. Hydrated too. I love using it t to remove my makeup at night. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purpose

As someone with extremely dry skin who doesn't like putting moisturizer on at night, this cleanser is a new favorite! I used it at night after removing my makeup, and it leaves my skin feeling clean, but moisturized. I love that it's unscented and a little goes a long way. I will definitely repurchase once I go through this bottle. My skin is pretty sensitive, and have not had any abnormal breakouts using this in combination with the moisturizer. My skin naturally is very red and I feel like this combination soothes that redness and has evened my skin tone. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Such a soft buttery cleanser, I loved it because it was super gentle. However, you have to cleanse more than once for all your makeup to come off so, I would recommend using this as a morning cleanser.

The texture and application of this cleanser is so pleasant. It makes the whole experience feel luxurious, which I just love, especially when it comes to something I don't feel like doing everyday but should, having it feel luxurious helps encourage me to do it! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Great as a make up remover!
avis.texte: I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. Ok, functionality wise this worked really well! It helped with taking make up off but it didn't really make my face feel "clean". I almost wish it had some kind of foaming, I felt like I had to use another cleanser to really feel "clean" I would use it more like a make up remover than a "cleanser"

I absolutely love this face wash! I have struggled for so long to find something that works for my skin. I struggle with dry skin and acne particularly around my nose, and I wouldnt have thought a face wash not geared towards acne treatment would be what fits for me, but it absolutely does! My face feels less dry and I have a lot less acne around my nose. I am super happy with this product and will be continuing to use it! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I really like the texture of this product. It feels creamy and smooth when applied. I used this in tandem with the Clinique cream, which I love, so I am not sure which product does most of the work. I have sensitive skin and didn't have issues. I used twice a day and it feels clean and soft. I don't like how I have to use a towel to clean it off, but that's a minor issue. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I like the ease of use because you apply it to dry skin and wipe off. It removes impurities and leaves your skin free from debris and dirt. This is good for part of an evening skincare regimen. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Gentle cleansing, not ideal for heavy makeup!
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using this cleanser when I did not have a full face of makeup. It goes on smoothly and gently cleanses leaving skin feeling refreshed and because you don't have to rinse this I think it could be great for camping or on the go. But I found that it did not do a great job of removing my eye makeup and heavier foundation and that when I did try to use it I absolutely had to rinse with water and that it felt somewhat hydrophobic, making my skin feeling less fresh. The product feels soft and luxurious it just felt inadequate and also inconvenient to be wiping and wiping and not getting all my makeup, defeating the purpose of a gentle cleanser. I will continue to use this in the morning or on days I wear little to no makeup. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I absolutely love this face wash! I have sensitive skin that can be prone to breakouts, and this product didn't break me out at all! It is super gentle and is one of the only face washes I have used that doesn't make my skin feel tight and dry after. It also has a super lightweight feel and has a very light scent so it is not overpowering. Highly recommend for sensitive skin!! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I loved this product, I mainly used it at night. It was very convenient to use when I didn't feel like washing my face. I applied it as lotion and wipe it off with a damp cloth. It removed everything very easily and left my skin clean and soft. It was very soothing.

If you are struggling with a damaged skin barrier, rosacea flare-ups, or chronic dry sensitivity, this is worth every penny. This cleanser is so gentle and treats your skin like glass while still clearing away daily impurities. If you prefer a sudsy, deep-pore squeaky clean, you may want to pass—but for pure soothing power, it's a 10/10. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Clinique is such a staple brand, but occasionally I have had issues with some of their products irritating my skin, however this cleanser is really great. I double cleanse every night because I wear makeup so I have been using this after I use an oil cleanser. This does a great job getting the remaining makeup off my face while not stripping my skin. My face doesn't feel tight after using this, and I have had no issues of irritation. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I was sent the Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Face Cleanser and it's really nice! It foams up easily and leaves my skin feeling clean, smooth, and hydrated! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been using this cleanser in the evening and it's been gentle while still leaving my skin feeling clean and refreshed. The texture is smooth, rinses away easily and doesn't leave my skin feeling tight or stripped. I also like that it's fragrance free, making it a great option for sensitive skin. Highly Recommend! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Face Cleanser
avis.texte: I used this in the morning and it left my skin feeling soft and hydrated without any tightness. It had a light fragrance to it and easily removed with a damp cloth. However, it does not remove water proof mascara or long wear makeup, so it is best to use as a cleanser before putting on makeup. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Excellent cleanser for soft clean skin
avis.texte: This face cleanser is perfect for taking off my makeup after a long day. I have relatively sensitive skin and I've had absolutely no issues with this cleanser. It takes off my makeup so well and is really gentle on the skin. It's very easy to use and SO convenient. My skin feels soft and clean after using this. Definitely a must have. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I like this cleanser. There is not a scent that I noticed. It is a very creamy cleanser. It doesn't foam. But I feel it does a good job cleansing my face without stripped it to much. My face feels hydrated and clean after using it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: This is the most gentle cleanser ever!
avis.texte: I used this in both the morning and evening and love how gentle it actually is. Unlike many cleansers this doesn't foam up, you simple gently rub it onto your face then wipe it off with a cloth or rinse with water which isn't necessary. It did not irritate my skin not even the gently skin around my eyes. It is fragrance free which for me is I portant as it can be overwhelming for my eyes. It left my skin feeling soft and moisturized without that tight and stiff feeling I have gotten from past cleansers. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been using the Gentle Cream Cleanser every morning and night, along with the Calm Balm, and my skin has honestly never looked better. I have sensitive, dry skin, so I'm always careful about the products I use, and I really appreciate that this cleanser is completely fragrance-free and doesn't irritate my skin at all. One of my favorite things about this cleanser is that it's a non-foaming cream formula, which makes washing my face way less messy. Even though it doesn't foam, my skin still feels super clean. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been using the Clinique Daily Calm™ Gentle Cream Cleanser mostly in the evening to remove the day's buildup, though I also used it a few mornings when my skin felt a little dry or sensitive. It left my skin feeling clean and refreshed without making it feel tight or stripped, which I really appreciated. The texture is creamy and smooth, making it easy to massage onto my skin before rinsing off. I also liked that it has a very mild, subtle scent that isn't overpowering, making it a pleasant option for everyday use. Overall, I had a positive experience with this cleanser. It was gentle, comfortable to use, and worked well as part of my routine. I'm giving it 4 stars because while it cleansed effectively, I would have liked it to remove heavier makeup a little more easily without needing a second cleanse. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Ive been a lifelong user of Clinique makeup and skincare products so when Topboxcircle and Clinique sent me a full size product to review i was so excited. Of course I absolutely love the creamy, velvety texture that leaves the skin beautifully hydrated and supple. It's my new favorite step in my nighttime skincare routine.

This creamy cleanser really surprised me. I was somewhat new to Clinique skincare, but this product had me wanting to try other products! I typically have combination skin, sometimes more on the oily side, and this is calming and leaves my skin feeling hydrated. I also can experience sensitivities but this did not irritate my skin in the least bit. It has a great texture but don't look for it to create bubbles, foam, or a "clarifying" effect. I enjoy using it in the morning as my only cleanser. At night I use it as my first cleanse to remove my makeup or the first layer of the day. Great results for both purposes and no breakouts! Give it a try, I imagine it will work well with all skin types. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This is the best face cleanser! It's very gentle on the skin and leaves no oily residue behind. It's very light weight and glides on very smoothly and evenly. It also washes away very easily and leaves my skin feeling very soft and smooth. Highly recommend this product! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I have used this cream cleanser a few times and have really enjoyed it. It easily removes all of my makeup and leaves my face feeling smooth and moisturized. I have both left on the cream and also rinsed it off, and have enjoyed using it both ways!

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. This cleanser is everything I look for in a daily face wash. It effectively removes my sunscreen, makeup, and dirt while leaving my skin feeling soft instead of tight or stripped. The creamy texture is luxurious, and it rinses clean without residue. It's a great choice for anyone with normal, dry, or sensitive skin who wants a simple, effective cleanser.

This cleanser is very nice, once you get used to the method. It was the first time I've used a cleanser that doesn't require water and doesn't lather up, so I was skeptical at first. But it did the job! It feels soothing during application, and my skin does not feel dry or irritated afterward. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This is such a great everyday cleanser. As someone with really sensitive skin, I appreciate how soft this leaves my skin. I have zero issues with tightness or my skin feeling stripped after using this. It offers a nice lather and rinses fairly easily. I do think it's a little too gentle for super stubborn makeup, so I usually pair this with an oil to remove my mascara or waterproof eyeliner. But I find myself reaching for this quite a bit because it is gentle, but effective. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I have been using the cream cleanser for a couple weeks now and enjoy using it in the mornings. I feel that it does a good job of removing excess dirt and oil without irritating my skin. It leaves my face feeling clean. I wear makeup almost daily so on light makeup days, I'll use this cleaner at night but on heavier makeup days, I prefer using makeup removing foaming cleansers. Overall, it's worth a try. It's easy to use and effective. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser
avis.texte: During application of the Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser my skin felt soothed, calm, relaxed and non irritated. The Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser quickly dissolves into facial skin, and is easy to remove with a damp cloth without rinsing. The Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser does not strip the skin's barrier, and leaves the skin looking soft, plump and supple. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I have been using the Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser for a few weeks now and I am impressed with the results. There is no scent to the product, and you are instructed to massage onto a dry face and wipe off with a cloth. I have typically been applying this to my face when I get in the shower and then rinse it off gently with warm water. The instructions specifically state to apply to the eyelids and at first I was skeptical. I do occasionally get eye milia and am very sensitive around the eyes. I followed the instructions as described, and my eye milia cleared up. I don't think this is the only factor to consider, but I was really pleased. I will continue to use this. With it being summer I didn't see a huge reduction in redness, but that is also because I have been in the sun more. I can tell that my skin isn't as irritated as it has been in the past, and I believe this has helped that. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I have been using the Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Cleanser for a while now, and it has truly transformed my skincare routine. From the very first use, I noticed how incredibly soft and soothing the texture is on my skin. It effectively removes impurities without ever feeling harsh, leaving my face feeling clean, refreshed, and perfectly balanced. ​What I love most is how gentle this formula is. The infusion of magnolia makes it feel like a luxurious, spa-like experience every time I wash my face. My skin feels hydrated and calm immediately after rinsing, which is exactly what I need. It is a fantastic addition to my daily regimen, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable, soothing cleanser that truly delivers on its promises. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes
I love this cleanser it leaves my face feeling soft and clean

I love the Clinique brand and this product holds up to its name! It's perfect for my sensitive skin and it gives 2 different options of how to remove it from your skin. It's supposed to be applied to dry skin and then wiped off with a dry or damp cloth. I tried it both ways and I do prefer wiping it off with a damp cloth. It can even be applied to my eyelids! I've never applied a cleanser to my eyelids! That was one of the highlights of this cleanser for me! Also I think it would be a great addition to my toiletries travel bag! I love to travel! Whether it be airplanes, buses, trains or road trips this product would add a soft glamorous classy touch! You wouldn't even have to leave your seat! Just apply a little to your skin and wipe it off! It would be awesome while camping too. Places where your skin needs refreshing and you don't have access to clean bathrooms or water.. Thanks Clinique for an amazing product! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This cleanser is wonderful for my red irritated skin. It cleans, moisturizes well, and has no irritating fragrance and really calms my redness. I have used this every evening to remove my makeup followed by my toner and the the Clinique daily calm cream. Excellent choice for those with dry irritated skin. I received this product free from Clinique for testing and review.

Finding a face wash that actually cleanses without triggering my sensitive skin has been a massive struggle, but this one is a total game-changer. The texture feels like a rich, velvety lotion that glides over the skin with zero friction. I love that it's completely non-foaming and packed with glycerin and hyaluronic acid—it feels incredibly hydrating. I typically massage it on and gently wipe it off with a damp cloth, and my skin is left feeling soft, clean, and genuinely calm instead of stripped or tight. It has noticeably helped tone down my everyday redness. If your skin barrier is angry or easily irritated, you absolutely need to try this! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
like it name Gentle Cream cleanser , i feel my skin supper soft after using , cleaned exactly what i am looking for. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I got this product about a month ago. I used it at night time when I got home from work and too tired to do my facial routine. I dont wear makeup to work, so I cant say whether or not it removes them. I liked the feeling of it and it wiped off easily. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This face wash is a clean and safe cleanser for dry skin. It is not too thick and feels lightweight on the skin. I like to use this cleanser with my normal routine, washing my face at night. It does not leave my skin red, irritated, or dry. I have acne prone skin so this is great for my needs. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I really enjoyed the feeling of how this cleanser left my skin! I used it morning to start my day and at night as part of a double cleanse to remove makeup. It worked really well in getting that tough to remove mascara and lip stain off without harsh rubbing or scrubbing. I have sensitive skin that has been irritated lately and this was a game-changer! I also like that it doesn't have a harsh smell! This is definitely my new go-to!

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I have sensitive skin, so I usually just use warm water to wash my face in the morning. The summer causes me has more oil on my T-zone, so I use this cleanser as my morning routine now. It's very gentle. It gives my skin refreshing but not tight feelings. No irritation so far. I like it.
